category_title: Primary students with high reading motivation but low behavioral engagement due to distractibility
minimal_context: The student is participating in a 30-minute pullout reading intervention session to complete Wilson Fundations drills and read LLI texts.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's start our 30-minute reading session by doing our Wilson Fundations drills.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I like coming here. I can read books out of order.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay. Please look at the drill sheet now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks away from the drill sheet, becoming distracted by the other materials on the table) Can we look at the books?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to finish the drills first. Keep trying.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Appears somewhat less engaged, looking around the room instead of focusing on the task) But I want to read books out of order.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's start our 30-minute reading session by doing our Wilson Fundations drills.

STUDENT: I like coming here. I can read books out of order.

TUTOR: Okay. Please look at the drill sheet now.

STUDENT: (Looks away from the drill sheet, becoming distracted by the other materials on the table) Can we look at the books?

TUTOR: We need to finish the drills first. Keep trying.

STUDENT: (Appears somewhat less engaged, looking around the room instead of focusing on the task) But I want to read books out of order.

task.content: (1) reread one or more LLI-leveled texts, (2) do various Wilson Fundations drills, (3) be introduced to and begin reading a new LLI book, and (4) discuss and/or write about what was read.

context.environment: intervention lessons developed by Mrs. Lori (lead reading specialist)
context.materials: Fountas and Pinnell’s Leveled Literacy Intervention (LLI) texts (fiction and nonfiction), Wilson Fundations materials

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Exhibits distractibility, resulting in being rated as 'somewhat less engaged' than others by the researcher
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: indicated a preference for the intervention
related_quotes: Can read books out of order

behavior_patterns.condition: While participating in the standard intervention activities
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: distractibility noted by both the researcher and the teacher on engagement questionnaires
behavior_patterns.internal_state: motivated and prefers the intervention setting
related_quotes: Can read books out of order
